why.rationale: Four of five declared taste claims match shipped code with cited file:line evidence. CLAIM-4 (interactive-side-channel-integrity) is partial: the flag file IS removed on FIFO read or timeout (surface-envelope.sh:264), but the .run/waiting-on-operator.jsonl aggregator is append-only — instead of 'removing' the waiting entry, the script appends a follow-up 'envelope.operator-responded' event (line 265). The claim's literal 'removed' verb misfits jsonl semantics; the intent (lifecycle closure visible in aggregator) is met. All other invariants hold including exit-code 1/2 split, 80-col/24-line caps, field provenance, and graceful-degradation on surface failure.
decisions_considered: Whether jsonl-append-as-lifecycle-close satisfies the 'removed' verb in CLAIM-4 (concluded: partial)
Whether line 265's _aggregator_append running unconditionally after timeout counts as 'cleanup'
Whether CLAIM-3's slug-resolution needed --no-resolve carve-out verification
Whether CLAIM-5's `2>/dev/null` on surface call violates graceful degradation
Whether CLAIM-1's textwrap of rationale counts as 'inferred field'
